caseStudy.scope: An AR tool designed for car owners and repair professionals.  worked as part of a team, contributing to UX design, research, and usability testing, but you were not the UX lead.
caseStudy.introduction: This innovative application leverages AR technology to empower car owners and transform the learning experience for auto repair professionals.
caseStudy.header2:
My Role in Shaping the User Experience

As a UX team member, I worked collaboratively with a diverse group, including:

  • Gideon Adeyemi – UX Designer
  • Shamim Moghaddam – UX Designer
  • Bisola Oyekan – UX Designer
  • Eucharia Chigbu – UX Researcher

My contributions to Autospace focused on creating an intuitive and user-friendly AR solution. Key areas of my involvement included:

  • User Research: Together with another team member, I was responsible for conducting user research, ensuring that the app’s design was tailored to the needs of both car owners and auto repair professionals.
  • Color Selection: I participated in choosing the color scheme to ensure the design was visually appealing while maintaining accessibility.
  • Usability Testing: I was actively involved in usability testing, gathering insights to refine and optimize the user interface and overall experience.
  • Sketching & Design: I contributed to sketching low-fidelity wireframes, outlining the app’s layout and user flow to ensure a seamless and efficient design.

caseStudy.title: Skincare App
caseStudy.caption: A personalised skincare platform I designed independently, focusing on sustainability and inclusivity. I handled all aspects of design, from user research to creating an accessible layout with features like tailored product recommendations and educational content.
caseStudy.scope: A personalised skincare platform I designed independently, focusing on sustainability and inclusivity. I handled all aspects of design, from user research to creating an accessible layout with features like tailored product recommendations and educational content.
caseStudy.introduction: In this project, I focused on creating an engaging skincare e-commerce platform for Skinbuddy, a fictional skincare brand dedicated to personalized routines and sustainable practices. The design aimed to address common user needs in skincare by offering features that encourage daily habits and mindful product choices.
caseStudy.header2:
As the sole designer on this project, I was responsible for every aspect of Skinbuddy, from research to design execution. My contributions included:

  • Conducting User Research: I gathered insights into users’ skincare habits, common challenges, and preferences. This research guided my design decisions, ensuring Skinbuddy would be both functional and supportive of users’ skincare journeys.
  • Developing Wireframes & Prototypes: I created wireframes to outline the structure and navigation flow and built interactive prototypes to test and validate my design, ensuring an intuitive experience.
  • Choosing an Inviting Color Scheme: I selected a calming and balanced color palette that reinforces Skinbuddy’s brand identity while maintaining accessibility through high contrast.
  • Creating Interactive Reminders and Personalization Features: I integrated features like daily routine reminders and personalized recommendations, emphasizing a proactive and engaging experience.

Here are the key features and design choices that enhance the usability, personalization, and sustainability focus of this project:

  • Personalized Skincare Recommendations: Each user receives curated product suggestions based on their skin type, concerns, and preferences, allowing for a highly personalized shopping experience.
  • Daily Routine Reminders: Skinbuddy provides daily reminders to encourage users to follow their skincare routines regularly, helping them build consistent habits for healthier skin.
  • Eco-Friendly Product Emphasis: Skinbuddy highlights eco-friendly and sustainable products, with each product page showcasing the brand’s commitment to the environment, promoting responsible shopping choices.
  • Clear and Accessible Layout: The design includes a clean, intuitive layout with well-organized categories and clear labels, making it easy to navigate. A calming color palette with high contrast enhances readability and accessibility for all users.
caseStudy.result: The Skinbuddy design embodies the balance of personalization and sustainability in an e-commerce platform. By encouraging consistent skincare habits and promoting eco-friendly choices, Skinbuddy provides a valuable and mindful shopping experience. This project allowed me to deepen my understanding of designing for both usability and sustainability, creating an experience that resonates with modern, conscious consumers.

caseStudy.header2:
For this project, I focused on building an inclusive and accessible e-commerce platform for a fictional fashion retail brand, DAMFASH. The goal was to address common accessibility challenges while providing a seamless, enjoyable shopping experience for all users, including those with disabilities. Below are the key features and design decisions that emphasize the platform’s accessibility and usability:

1. Accessible Navigation and Visibility

Alt Text for Product Images:

Each product image is equipped with descriptive alt text, ensuring that visually impaired users can understand the product details via screen readers, enhancing their shopping experience.

Clear Cart Visibility:

The number of items in the shopping cart is prominently displayed, allowing users to easily keep track of their purchases, which reduces frustration and improves accessibility for users with cognitive disabilities.

2. Interactive Styling Guide

"Watch How Clothes are Styled" Feature:

An interactive feature enables users to watch videos demonstrating how various clothes can be styled. This feature not only enriches the shopping experience but also helps users make informed decisions by seeing products in context.

3. Sign Language Support

Sign Language Video Assistance:

To support the hearing-impaired community, DAMFASH includes videos featuring a sign language instructor. These videos provide tutorials on how to navigate the website, along with styling tips, making the platform accessible and user-friendly for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.

4. High Contrast Design

Color Contrast for Visual Clarity:

Careful attention was given to color contrast throughout the website to ensure that text, buttons, and other essential elements are highly readable, even for users with visual impairments. The contrast ratios adhere to WCAG standards, while the color scheme maintains an appealing, modern aesthetic.

5. Comprehensive Product Information

Detailed Product Descriptions:

Each product page includes thorough descriptions covering fabric type, design details, and unique features. This detailed information ensures that all users, especially those relying on screen readers, can fully understand the product before making a purchase.

6. User-Friendly Layout

Intuitive and Clean Design:

The website layout was designed to be intuitive, with clear navigation and labels for product categories. Related products are also displayed to enhance discoverability. The design ensures that all users, regardless of their ability, can easily navigate the platform and find what they are looking for.
